name: Select Brands LLC
old_description: Select Brands is a leading contract manufacturer serving one of the fastest-growing segments of the food industry: thermally processed, shelf-stable, ready-to-eat products in flexible packaging. We provide expert, individualized guidance throughout the entire commercialization process, partnering with customers from initial concept development through full-scale production.
about:
Select Brands LLC was founded in 2004 in Springfield, Missouri. The company began as a full-service contract packer specializing in ready-to-eat foods packaged in flexible stand-up pouches.

The company provides turnkey and tolling co-manufacturing services, including retort and hot-fill processing, ultrasonic sealing, metal detection, and time-temperature-pressure monitoring. Its flexible packaging lines produce gusseted, spouted, and pillow pouches for retail and foodservice sizes, with production runs ranging from 10,000 to over 100,000 pouches. In-house R&D supports concept development, heat penetration studies, and scale-up.

Select Brands serves the food industry, focusing on thermally processed, shelf-stable, ready-to-eat products. Its customers include retail brands, private-label store brands, national brands, and foodservice operators who need consistent, shelf-ready pouches without building their own plants.

The company emphasizes flexibility in customizing production to each client’s goals, advanced technology such as ultrasonic seals and real-time process monitoring, and a quality management system validated by third-party audits including SQF. Consistency across runs is monitored closely to ensure uniformity.
